dedupe_keys.name: shelterwave v0 1 a five wave municipal panel of japan s individual evacuation plan and registry surveys 2022 2026

description: Kunihisa Ohno publishes ShelterWave, a five-wave panel of Japanese municipalities’ registries and individual plans for residents needing evacuation assistance. Zenodo lists a public CC BY 4.0 archive at no cost, reconstructed from national municipality-level PDF tables for 2022–2026. The described long-format CSV covers all 1,741 municipalities with wave, code, plan and roster counts, rates, sharing counts where available, balance flags and quality notes. The archive also includes provenance, extraction and checking scripts. These rates can inform emergency-service readiness baselines or compare preparedness assumptions in regional evacuation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the panel. A limitation is that plan creation is an administrative measure, not evidence that a person can be evacuated during an event. The page title says v0.1 while the visible archive filename says v0.2, a version discrepancy requiring file-level checking. The ZIP was not downloaded and extracted counts were not recalculated.
